Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who displays genuine concern for her mistress. She is deeply devoted to her mistress's well-being and overall condition.

## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) was a fourteen-year-old maid who lived and worked at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) lost their way in the woods, Charlotta and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) welcomed them into the house for tea. Charlotta later confided her concerns to [Anne](../character/anne.md) about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior, which prompted [Anne](../character/anne.md) to stay for extended visits. During one such visit, Charlotta helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the arrival of Miss Lavendar's former fiancé, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and anxiously waited in the kitchen with [Anne](../character/anne.md) until the couple reconciled. She then spent the following month assisting Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) with the wedding preparations leading up to the garden ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +222 more_

## Quotes

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> "I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?"
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "Yes, ma’am. Come in, ma’am. I’ll tell Miss Lavendar you’re here, ma’am. She’s upstairs, ma’am."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana.md)

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) meet when [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally lose their way in the woods and end up at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta joins her employer in warmly welcoming [Diana](../character/diana.md) as a guest for a pretend tea party. [Diana](../character/diana.md) later returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) to help Charlotta and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding.

- Friend of — welcomes her warmly at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) works as a young maid and servant at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for her eccentric employer, Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), who bestows the name Charlotta on all her young helpers. Charlotta is deeply devoted to Miss Lavendar's well-being, confiding her worries to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her mistress exhibits melancholy behavior and taking part in hosting guests and preparing the household for Miss Lavendar's eventual wedding.

- Serves under — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>
